title: Suit & Steel: ULPPL Routine
author: Aaron R.
desc:
A targeted 5-day hypertrophy routine designed specifically for people who don't want to spend all day in the gym. 

Structured around a balanced Upper, Lower, Push, Pull, Legs split,—all achievable in efficient 60-minute sessions.

Perfect for those balancing academics, work, and personal fitness goals.
